title: How My Predictions Are Faring
author: Ray Kurzweil

entries.quote: Translating telephone technology is likely to become quite popular on many smartphones worldwide in 2010.
entries.subject: Translating telephone apps

entries.quote: One of my key (and consistent) predictions is that a computer will pass the Turing test by 2029.
entries.subject: Turing test passed
entries.note: Restates earlier books. The essay refers to the Long Bets wager with Mitch Kapor (Long Bet 1) on the same claim.

entries.quote: In my view, it will take about two decades to fully simulate the human brain, around 2029, but that is still not far away.
entries.subject: Full human brain simulation

notes: Mainly a self-assessment of earlier books; the author's verdicts are in self_assessment.json. This file holds only the new or restated forward claims in the author's own voice with an explicit year. Forecasts the essay attributes to others (IDC, analysts, IBM, Cray, Blue Brain) are not captured.
